'''Europa FC''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club from [[Gibraltar]] that competes in the [[Gibraltar National League]]. As other clubs in the territory, Europa FC currently shares the [[Victoria Stadium (Gibraltar)|Victoria Stadium]] on [[Winston Churchill Avenue, Gibraltar|Winston Churchill Avenue]]. The club also operates a [[Europa F.C. Women|women's team]] which competes in the [[Gibraltar Women's Football League]]."}}
